title: Common definitions
description: Definitions shared by the nodr/v1alpha1 schemas.

name.description: A resource name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

secretRef.description: The name of a secret in the secrets service, such as proxmox/pve-main-token. The value never appears in the workspace.

quantity.description: A size such as 512Mi, 4Gi or 1.5Gi. Binary suffixes (Ki, Mi, Gi, Ti, Pi) are powers of 1024, decimal suffixes (k, M, G, T, P) powers of 1000.

ipv4Prefix.description: An IPv4 address with a prefix length, such as 10.0.20.21/24.

ipv4Range.description: An inclusive IPv4 address range, such as 10.0.30.100-10.0.30.249.

proxmoxName.description: An identifier used by Proxmox VE, such as a storage ID or a bridge name.
